newsitem.title: USA: Credit Suisse to cut some NY forex staff.
newsitem.headline: Credit Suisse to cut some NY forex staff.

text.p: Credit Suisse, a subsidiary of CS Holding, will lay off some foreign exchange staff at its New York branch on Tuesday as part of a reorganization with CS First Boston, the company acknowledged on Tuesday.
"There will be people laid off, which is part of the restructuring," said a spokesman for Credit Suisse in New York, responding to a question about market rumors. "Actually, it is being done today."
"But there will be no further significant announcements beyond that," the spokesman added.
The layoffs in New York will involve a combination of trading, sales and operations staff, the spokesman said. He declined to be specific about the number of staff involved.
"It's not a dramatic restructuring and it is not a large number," he added.

He said the cuts came as a result of the reorganization the bank announced in July. At that time, the bank forecast staff reductions of 5,000 worldwide, or 15 percent of its total workforce, over two to three years.
After January 1, the commercial banking activities of Credit Suisse will be conducted under the Credit Suisse First Boston name. -- NY Treasury Desk 212 859 1667
